source_data.desc: As humans invented the first gearforged, it should be no surprise that the human chassis remains the one that is most frequently encountered. However, it would be a mistake to assume that simply because the original chassis is more commonplace that there is anything common about them. While dwarves, gnomes, and kobolds have made clever additions and changes to the base model, the human chassis remains extremely versatile and is battle-proven.
source_data.name: Human Chassis

traits.desc: One ability score of your choice increases by 1.

traits.desc: You gain proficiency in two skills or tools of your choice. Choose one of those skills or tools or another skill or tool proficiency you have. Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses the chosen skill or tool.

traits.desc: When you roll a 9 or lower on the d20 for an ability check, you can use a reaction to change the roll to a 10. You can't use this trait again until you finish a short or long rest.

en.description: As humans invented the first gearforged, it should be no surprise that the human chassis remains the one that is most frequently encountered. However, it would be a mistake to assume that simply because the original chassis is more commonplace that there is anything common about them. While dwarves, gnomes, and kobolds have made clever additions and changes to the base model, the human chassis remains extremely versatile and is battle-proven.
en.name: Human Chassis

ru.description: Поскольку люди изобрели первых шестерённокованных, не должно быть сюрпризом, что человеческий корпус остаётся наиболее часто встречающимся. Однако было бы ошибкой предполагать, что просто потому, что оригинальный корпус более распространён, в них есть что-то обычное. В то время как дворфы, гномы и кобольды внесли умные дополнения и изменения в базовую модель, человеческий корпус остаётся чрезвычайно универсальным и проверенным в бою.
ru.name: Человеческий корпус
